bank_statement_entry_open_idx.name: bank_statement_entry_open_idx

invoice_cost_supplier_open_idx.name: invoice_cost_supplier_open_idx

invoice_cost_haulier_open_idx.name: invoice_cost_haulier_open_idx
invoice_cost_haulier_open_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND paid_on IS NULL AND haulier_id IS NOT NULL AND source_trucking_ref IS NULL AND source_master_job_ref IS NULL

invoice_cost_unlinked_open_idx.name: invoice_cost_unlinked_open_idx
invoice_cost_unlinked_open_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND paid_on IS NULL AND supplier_customer_id IS NULL AND haulier_id IS NULL AND source_trucking_ref IS NULL AND source_master_job_ref IS NULL

invoice_cost_supplier_used_idx.name: invoice_cost_supplier_used_idx
invoice_cost_supplier_used_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND supplier_customer_id IS NOT NULL

invoice_cost_haulier_used_idx.name: invoice_cost_haulier_used_idx
invoice_cost_haulier_used_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND haulier_id IS NOT NULL

receivable_payment_waiting_idx.name: receivable_payment_waiting_idx

receivable_payment_taken_back_kind_check.name: receivable_payment_taken_back_kind_check
receivable_payment_taken_back_kind_check.value: "receivable_payment"."taken_back_kind" IS NULL OR ("receivable_payment"."taken_back_kind" = 'mistake' AND "receivable_payment"."reversed_on" IS NULL) OR ("receivable_payment"."taken_back_kind" = 'reversed' AND "receivable_payment"."reversed_on" IS NOT NULL)

supplier_invoice_supplier_idx.name: supplier_invoice_supplier_idx
